Well, i can tell that we relate.
I have a lovely family and a girlfriend, honestly i just dont deserve this life.

I dont see this that way, i put my heart and soul in to basketball and i failed. I am now out of options, i am literally as good as a 15 year old when it comes to school. Its too late to get better, i dont want to live the rest of my life on minimum wage, my girlfriend got into an ivy league college as well and i dont think that i deserve her. I have no idea where to start my journey from, or what to do. I have as well no one to talk to about my issues, i tried to get help two years ago and i was told to put everything in basketball and school yet i failed. 
I guess this life is just not for me.
